tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

1: # M8 管理台后端（原 X2）实施计划
2: 
3: > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4: 
5: **Goal:** 在不新增数据库迁移的前提下，为管理控制台交付真实契约：用户列表/详情/角色与状态管理、只读概览、平台默认指令、系统技能、系统 MCP、全局 Agent 的查询与管理，复用 M7 的 `AdminUser` 门禁、既有领域服务、统一错误信封与游标分页，并同步 OpenAPI / `docs/api.md` / 前端交接。
6: 
7: **Architecture:** 新增 `app/modules/admin/` 作为**薄 HTTP 适配层**（`router.py` / `schemas.py` / `service.py`）：只有「用户管理」与「概览」是全新业务，SQL 与规则放 `admin/service.py`；平台指令、系统技能、系统 MCP、全局 Agent 的校验、审计与生效优先级仍留在各自领域服务（`instructions` / `skills` / `mcp` / `agents`），管理路由只做参数转换与 `AdminUser` 门禁，避免复制 SSRF、`secret:` 解析、`force_disabled` 合并等易漂移逻辑。所有新端点挂在 `/api/v1/admin/*`，读接口不分页或复用不透明游标，写接口落审计；**无迁移**。
8: 
9: **Tech Stack:** FastAPI、SQLAlchemy 2.x async、Pydantic v2、pytest-asyncio、httpx、PostgreSQL（复用本机 `dev_postgres`）。不新增第三方依赖。
10: 
11: **Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-m7-m9-backend-roadmap-design.md` §4（M8 范围/验收/非目标）
12: 
13: **前置基线:** M7-2 已交付 `AdminUser` RBAC（403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"` + `security.rbac_denied` 审计）；当前迁移 head `2d8f6a1c3e70`；M7 结束时的全量测试全绿。
14: 
15: ## Global Constraints
16: 
17: - Python `>=3.13`；ruff `line-length = 100`；代码注释、docstring、API 描述、用户可见错误消息一律中文。
18: - **不新增迁移**：M8 只读写既有列，禁止修改 `app/db/models/` 与 `alembic/versions/`。已核对：
19:   `users.role/status`（M1）、`system_settings`/`user_settings`（M1）、`skills.scope/enabled/force_disabled` 与 `mcp_servers.scope/enabled/force_disabled`（M1.5）、`remote_agents.owner_user_id`（M2）、`user_capability_overrides`（M1.5）均已存在；
20:   T8 必须用 `alembic check` 证明无漂移，且 `alembic/versions/` 无新文件。
21: - 复用既有依赖/信封/分页/审计，不自造：
22:   - 路由依赖 `app.core.deps.AdminUser` / `DbSession`；403 由 M7 的 `require_admin` 统一产生；
23:   - 错误一律 `app.core.errors` 的 `DomainError` 子类 + `code` 参数；
24:   - 列表游标用 `app.core.cursor.encode_cursor/decode_cursor`，非法游标必须 422 `validation_error`；
25:   - 审计用 `app.core.audit.write_audit`，`detail` 只放长度/指纹/字段名/状态值，**不放正文、明文密钥、密文、请求头**。
26: - **管理端配置面不受能力总开关影响**（R1）：`GET/PUT /admin/settings/instruction`、`GET/PUT /admin/skills*`、`GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /admin/mcp/servers*` 在 `INSTRUCTIONS_ENABLED/SKILLS_ENABLED/MCP_ENABLED=false` 时仍可读写持久化配置；运行态接口（`/instructions`、`/skills`、`/mcp`、聊天）行为不变。
27: - 测试零网络、零外部存储、零新容器：MCP 用 `app.modules.mcp.service.register_test_transport` + `tests/helpers.make_mcp_transport`；A2A 用 `app.modules.a2a.client.register_test_transport` + `tests/fixtures/fake_a2a_agent.FakeA2aAgent`；Embedding 用 fake；数据库用 `TEST_DATABASE_URL` 指向本机已有 PostgreSQL，缺库时 skip。
28: - 不新增配置项：`Settings` 与 `.env.example` **零变更**（如实现中想加开关，先停下确认，不在 M8 私自扩）。
29: - 不修改 M7 范围（续流/RBAC/审批字段/授权 URL 白名单）；M8 只消费 M7 的 403 契约。
30: - 不实现非目标：密码重置/强制下线、多角色 RBAC、数据导出/批量操作、前端页面本身。
31: - 提交只在本地、不推送、不删分支；提交时使用**显式路径**，禁止 `git add -A`（仓库存在 `.dsh/sessions` 等运行时文件）。
32: 
33: ## Review Focus
34: 
35: 1. **最后一个活跃管理员保护**：降级/停用目标后是否仍至少剩 1 个 `role='admin' AND status='active'`；并发互相降级时用行锁串行化。测试：T1 `test_last_active_admin_is_protected`。
36: 2. **不能把自己锁死**：管理员不能修改自己的 `role`、不能停用自己的 `status`；自操作返回 422 而不是静默成功。测试：T1 `test_cannot_change_own_role` / `test_cannot_disable_self`。
37: 3. **密钥不泄露**：系统 MCP / 全局 Agent 的响应、审计、日志不得出现明文/密文/请求头值，只允许 `secret:`/`env:` 引用与 `credentials_hint`/`auth_hint`。测试：T5 `test_system_mcp_secret_ref_never_echoed`、T6 `test_admin_agent_secret_ref_and_headers_not_echoed`。
38: 4. **403 信封一致**：任何 `/admin/*` 非管理员访问都必须是 403 `forbidden` + `details.required_role="admin"`，未登录 401；不能出现 404/500 或空 `details`。测试：T1 `test_non_admin_forbidden_and_unauthorized`，T2–T6 各文件各有一条 403 用例。
39: 5. **审计覆盖与不泄密**：用户改角色/状态、平台指令保存/恢复、系统技能启停/强制停用、系统 MCP 增删改、全局 Agent PATCH 都写审计，`action/resource_type/resource_id` 稳定；`detail` 不含正文与凭据。测试：T1/T3/T4/T5/T6 的 audit 断言。
40: 6. **概览不做 N+1 / 不拉行**：`GET /admin/overview` 必须用 SQL `count`/`sum` + 单次 `GROUP BY`，不得 `select(Model)` 后 Python 循环；一次请求的 SELECT 数有上界（≤10，含鉴权）。测试：T2 `test_overview_uses_bounded_queries`。精确计数在 PostgreSQL 上仍可能扫表，这是可接受的（管理端低频只读），但不接受按状态逐条查询或加载 ORM 行。
41: 
42: ## 文件结构
43: 
44: ```text
45: app/modules/admin/                 # 新增：管理台薄适配层
46: ├── __init__.py                    # 包声明
47: ├── router.py                      # 全部 /admin/* 路由（prefix="/admin", tags=["管理台"]）
48: ├── schemas.py                     # 管理台 DTO：用户/概览/平台指令/系统技能统计/请求体
49: └── service.py                     # 用户管理 + 概览（唯一新增业务 SQL）
50: 
51: app/modules/instructions/service.py  # 修改：平台默认读取/写入（复用 SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION）
52: app/modules/skills/service.py        # 修改：系统技能列表/启停/强制停用（复用 _skill_out/_effective_enabled）
53: app/modules/mcp/service.py           # 修改：系统 MCP 列表/创建/更新/删除（复用 _validate_create/normalize_headers/_check_and_sync）
54: app/modules/mcp/schemas.py           # 修改：AdminMcpServerUpdateRequest（含 enabled/force_disabled）
55: app/modules/agents/service.py        # 修改：admin_update_agent（复用 _apply_auth/_detail_with_recent）
56: app/modules/agents/schemas.py        # 修改：AdminAgentUpdateRequest（不可编辑字段显式 422）
57: app/api/v1/router.py                 # 修改：include admin_router（复用 COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES）
58: 
59: tests/integration/test_admin_users.py
60: tests/integration/test_admin_overview.py
61: tests/integration/test_admin_instructions.py
62: tests/integration/test_admin_skills.py
63: tests/integration/test_admin_mcp.py
64: tests/integration/test_admin_agents.py
65: 
66: docs/api.md                          # 修改：§1 错误码、§2.12 管理端、§7.6 分页、新增 §11 M8 状态
67: docs/openapi.json                    # 重新导出
68: docs/feedback/2026-11-11-m8-frontend-handoff.md   # 新增
69: docs/feedback/2026-11-11-m8-backend-report.md     # 新增（T8）
70: README.md / docs/roadmap.md / docs/architecture.md / docs/database.md  # 状态与口径
71: ```
72: 
73: **为什么这样拆：**
74: 
75: - 管理台 15 个端点里 11 个是「参数转换 + 调用领域服务」，单独拆 `users.py`/`mcp.py` 等只会增加文件数；集中一个 `router.py` 便于核对 `/admin/*` 的 403 与 OpenAPI tag。
76: - 系统技能/MCP/Agent 的写规则与既有用户侧写接口共享同一套校验（SSRF、`secret:`、`force_disabled` 优先级、工具发现、审计），必须放回领域服务；若放 `admin/service.py` 会复制逻辑，后续两边漂移。
77: - 用户管理与概览是管理台独有、无既有领域服务可复用，放 `admin/service.py`，与路由同包、改动内聚。
78:

250: ### Task 3: 平台默认指令 `GET/PUT /api/v1/admin/settings/instruction`
251: 
252: **Files:**
253: - Modify: `app/modules/instructions/service.py`
254: - Modify: `app/modules/admin/router.py` / `schemas.py` / `service.py`
255: - Test: `tests/integration/test_admin_instructions.py`
256: 
257: **Interfaces:**
258: 
259: - 复用键 `instructions.schemas.SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION == "instruction.default"` 与内置 `DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION`；值兼容既有两种历史形态：`{"content": "..."}` 与裸字符串。
260: - `app.modules.instructions.service` 新增：
261:   - `async def get_platform_instruction(db: AsyncSession) -> tuple[str, SystemSetting | None]`：无行/形态非法 → `(DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION, None)`；有行 → `(content, row)`。
262:   - `async def set_platform_instruction(db: AsyncSession, admin: User, content: str | None) -> SystemSetting | None`：
263:     - `content` 长度 > `settings.instruction_max_chars` → 422 `instruction_too_long`（文案沿用现有）；
264:     - `content is None`：删除该 key（无行则 no-op）；
265:     - 非空：upsert `value={"content": content}`、`updated_by=admin.id`、**手动 `updated_at=datetime.now(UTC)`**（`SystemSetting` 没有 `onupdate`，只改 `updated_by` 不会自动刷新时间）；
266:     - `write_audit(action="instruction.update", resource_type="system_setting", resource_id="instruction.default", detail={"scope": "platform", "length": len(content), "fingerprint": content_fingerprint(content)} 或 {"scope": "platform", "restored_default": True})`，commit（复用既有动作名，detail.scope 区分平台/个人）。

async def get_effective(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> InstructionOut:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.instructions_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("指令能力未启用")
    user_setting = await db.get(UserSetting, user.id)
    user_value = user_setting.instructions if user_setting else None
    default_value, _ = await _default_instruction(db)
    if user_value is not None:
        effective, source = user_value, "user"
        updated_at = user_setting.updated_at if user_setting else _now()
    else:
        effective, source = default_value, "system_default"
        _, updated_at = await _default_instruction(db)
        updated_at = updated_at or _now()
    return InstructionOut(
        effective=effective,
        source=source,
        user_value=user_value,
        default_value=default_value,
        max_chars=settings.instruction_max_chars,
        updated_at=updated_at,
    )


async def update_instruction(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: InstructionUpdateRequest
) -> InstructionUpdateResult:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.instructions_enabled:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("指令能力未启用")
    content = payload.content
    if content is not None and len(content) > settings.instruction_max_chars:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"指令超过 {settings.instruction_max_chars} 字符上限",
            code="instruction_too_long",
        )
    user_setting = await db.get(UserSetting, user.id)
    if user_setting is None:
        user_setting = UserSetting(user_id=user.id, instructions=None)
        db.add(user_setting)
    user_setting.instructions = content
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="instruction.update",
        resource_type="user_setting",
        resource_id=str(user.id),
        detail={
            "length": len(content) if content else 0,
            "fingerprint": content_fingerprint(content) if content else None,
            "restored_default": content is None,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    effective = content if content is not None else (await _default_instruction(db))[0]
    source = "user" if content is not None else "system_default"
    return InstructionUpdateResult(
        effective=effective,
        source=source,
        max_chars=settings.instruction_max_chars,
        updated_at=_now(),
    )


async def effective_instruction_text(db: AsyncSession, user: User) -> str:
    """聊天装配用：返回当前生效指令文本（能力关闭时返回空串，不抛错）。"""
    if not get_settings().instructions_enabled:
        return ""
    user_setting = await db.get(UserSetting, user.id)
    if user_setting is not None and user_setting.instructions is not None:
        return user_setting.instructions
    default_value, _ = await _default_instruction(db)
    return default_value

async def set_skill_enabled(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, skill_id: uuid.UUID, enabled: bool
) -> SkillOut:
    skill = await _load_visible(db, user, skill_id)
    if skill.scope == "user":
        skill.enabled = enabled
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(user.id),
            action="skill.enable",
            resource_type="skill",
            resource_id=str(skill_id),
            detail={"enabled": enabled},
        )
    else:
        override = await db.get(UserCapabilityOverride, (user.id, "skill", skill.id))
        if override is None:
            override = UserCapabilityOverride(
                user_id=user.id, capability="skill", target_id=skill.id, enabled=enabled
            )
            db.add(override)
        else:
            override.enabled = enabled

            action="capability.override",
            resource_type="skill",
            resource_id=str(skill_id),
            detail={"capability": "skill", "enabled": enabled},
        )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(skill)
    effective = await _effective_enabled(db, skill, user)
    return _skill_out(skill, effective=effective)

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

async def test_instruction_default_flow(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    response = await client.get("/api/v1/instructions", headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body["source"] == "system_default"
    assert body["user_value"] is None
    assert body["default_value"]
    assert body["effective"] == body["default_value"]
    assert body["max_chars"] == 4000


async def test_instruction_override_and_restore(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    updated = await client.put(
        "/api/v1/instructions", json={"content": "请用要点式回答，先结论后依据。"}, headers=headers
    )
    assert updated.status_code == 200
    body = updated.json()
    assert body["source"] == "user"
    assert body["effective"] == "请用要点式回答，先结论后依据。"

    fetched = await client.get("/api/v1/instructions", headers=headers)
    assert fetched.json()["source"] == "user"
    assert fetched.json()["user_value"] == "请用要点式回答，先结论后依据。"

    # null 恢复默认
    restored = await client.put("/api/v1/instructions", json={"content": None}, headers=headers)
    assert restored.status_code == 200
    assert restored.json()["source"] == "system_default"
    fetched = await client.get("/api/v1/instructions", headers=headers)
    assert fetched.json()["user_value"] is None


async def test_instruction_too_long(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    too_long = await client.put(
        "/api/v1/instructions", json={"content": "字" * 4001}, headers=headers
    )
    assert too_long.status_code == 422
    assert too_long.json()["error"]["code"] == "instruction_too_long"

async def set_platform_instruction(
    db: AsyncSession, admin: User, content: str | None
) -> SystemSetting | None:
    """保存平台默认指令；``content is None`` 时删除覆盖并恢复内置默认。

    管理端配置面不受 ``instructions_enabled`` 总开关影响（R1），因此这里不调用
    ``_require_enabled``/``get_effective``。``SystemSetting`` 没有 ``onupdate``，
    只改 ``updated_by`` 不会自动刷新时间，必须手动写 ``updated_at``。
    """
    settings = get_settings()
    if content is not None and len(content) > settings.instruction_max_chars:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"指令超过 {settings.instruction_max_chars} 字符上限",
            code="instruction_too_long",
        )

    row = await db.get(SystemSetting, SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION)
    if content is None:
        if row is not None:
            await db.delete(row)
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(admin.id),
            action="instruction.update",
            resource_type="system_setting",
            resource_id=SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION,
            detail={"scope": "platform", "restored_default": True},
        )
        await db.commit()
        return None

    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    if row is None:
        row = SystemSetting(
            key=SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION,
            value={"content": content},
            updated_by=admin.id,
            updated_at=now,
        )
        db.add(row)
    else:
        row.value = {"content": content}
        row.updated_by = admin.id
        row.updated_at = now
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(admin.id),
        action="instruction.update",
        resource_type="system_setting",
        resource_id=SYSTEM_KEY_INSTRUCTION,
        detail={
            "scope": "platform",
            "length": len(content),
            "fingerprint": content_fingerprint(content),
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(row)
    return row

Instead, think of SQLAlchemy internals: `Session.delete(obj)` puts in `self._deleted`; on flush, object transitions to deleted state; on commit, `_finalize_loaded`? There's `SessionTransaction._finalize_loaded` which expires objects if expire_on_commit... The key part: `Session._remove_newly_deleted` and `session._deleted` cleanup occurs in `_flush`'s `postflush` via `_remove_newly_deleted` → `self._deleted.discard(instance)`; the instance identity remains in `identity_map` until `_expire`? Actually after delete flush, the instance is put into the "deleted" state and detached when transaction commits (state._deleted). `Session._get_impl` does:

```
if key in self.identity_map:
    instance = self.identity_map[key]
    ...
```

```
self._deleted.discard(state)
state._deleted = True
state.session_id = self.session_id
try: self.identity_map._remove(state)

```

def _escape_like(value: str) -> str:
    """转义 LIKE 通配符，避免 ``q`` 里的 %/_/\\ 扩大匹配范围。"""
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


async def list_system_skills(
    db: AsyncSession, *, q: str | None = None
) -> list[SkillOut]:
    """管理端系统技能列表：全局有效态，不合并任何用户覆盖（R1 配置面）。

    ``effective_enabled = enabled and not force_disabled`` 是技能对所有人的
    全局口径；用户级覆盖只影响运行态 ``/skills`` 与 catalog，这里不读取。
    """
    stmt = select(Skill).where(Skill.scope == "system")
    keyword = q.strip() if q else ""
    if keyword:
        pattern = f"%{_escape_like(keyword)}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(
            Skill.name.ilike(pattern, escape="\\")
            | Skill.description.ilike(pattern, escape="\\")
        )
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt.order_by(Skill.name.asc()))).scalars())
    return [
        _skill_out(row, effective=row.enabled and not row.force_disabled)
        for row in rows
    ]

"""``/api/v1`` 聚合路由。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.api.schemas import ErrorEnvelopeOut
from app.modules.admin.router import router as admin_router
from app.modules.agents.router import router as agents_router
from app.modules.approvals.router import router as approvals_router
from app.modules.attachments.router import router as attachments_router
from app.modules.audit.router import router as audit_router
from app.modules.auth.router import router as auth_router
from app.modules.chat.router import router as chat_router
from app.modules.conversations.router import router as conversations_router
from app.modules.instructions.router import router as instructions_router
from app.modules.knowledge.router import router as knowledge_router
from app.modules.mcp.router import router as mcp_router
from app.modules.memories.router import router as memories_router
from app.modules.secrets.router import router as secrets_router
from app.modules.skills.router import router as skills_router
from app.modules.system.router import router as system_router
from app.modules.tasks.router import router as tasks_router

# 所有业务端点共享的错误信封；集中声明，避免 OpenAPI 只有 2xx/422。
COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict] = {
    400: {"model": ErrorEnvelopeOut, "description": "请求不合法（bad_request）"},
    401: {"model": ErrorEnvelopeOut, "description": "未认证、access token 过期或刷新令牌失效"},
    403: {
        "model": ErrorEnvelopeOut,
        "description": "无权限、账号停用，或能力未启用（capability_disabled / auth_flow_unavailable）",
    },
    404: {"model": ErrorEnvelopeOut, "description": "资源不存在（也用于隐藏他人资源）"},
    409: {
        "model": ErrorEnvelopeOut,
        "description": (
            "状态冲突：run_in_progress（details.run_id）、run_not_cancelable"
            "（details.status）、run_not_resumable、workflow_disabled、"
            "approval_already_decided、approval_expired"
        ),
    },
    413: {"model": ErrorEnvelopeOut, "description": "请求体过大（payload_too_large）"},
    422: {
        "model": ErrorEnvelopeOut,
        "description": "参数校验失败（validation_error）或模型不在白名单（model_not_allowed）",
    },
    429: {
        "model": ErrorEnvelopeOut,
        "description": "触发限流（rate_limited），details.retry_after_seconds 为建议重试秒数",
    },
    500: {"model": ErrorEnvelopeOut, "description": "服务器内部错误（internal_error）"},
    503: {
        "model": ErrorEnvelopeOut,
        "description": "依赖服务不可用（service_unavailable，如 Embedding 服务不可达）",
    },
}

api_router = APIRouter()
api_router.include_router(admin_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(auth_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(conversations_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(chat_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(approvals_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(audit_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(attachments_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(instructions_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(knowledge_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(memories_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(secrets_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(skills_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(mcp_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(agents_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(tasks_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)
api_router.include_router(system_router, responses=COMMON_ERROR_RESPONSES)

No capability dependency at router level. ✅.

But `get_effective` calls `get_settings()` → same instance → False → 403. ✅. However, `register_user` isn't used; admin_auth token already created before monkeypatch; no issue.

I think spec compliance is solid. Let me now formulate the report.

But the output format wants:
### Spec Compliance
- ✅ Spec compliant | ❌ Issues found: [with file:line]
- ⚠️ Cannot verify from diff: [...]

Maybe I should list per-task thumbs with details. Let me structure:

### Spec Compliance

**T3 平台指令** — ✅ 合规
- 字段集精确匹配（[schemas.py](...#L67-L95)），无 effective_preview；测试用 `set(body) == _FIELDS` 固定。
- 领域函数签名/语义（[instructions/service.py:38](...#L38), [:51](...#L51), [:57](...#L57)）；legacy 两种形态；长度 422；null 删除；upsert value/updated_by/手动 updated_at（[instructions/service.py:89-107](...)）；审计 action/resource/detail scope+length/fingerprint / restored_default 且无正文。
- 管理端装配（[admin/service.py:253](...), [:280](...))；`user_override_count` IS NOT NULL 聚合；`updated_by_email` 查 User，缺失 null。

- 既有行为不变：`_default_instruction` 是薄包装且语义等价（对照 diff 前实现），现有 test_instructions.py 未改。

**T4 系统技能** — ✅ 合规
- 只查 system + name asc + q 转义（[skills/service.py:409](...)）；`_skill_out` 复用（[:426](...)）；effective 全局口径。
- 写端点 `_load_system_skill` 404（[skills/service.py:432](...)）；审计 action/detail 正确（[:440](...), [:460](...)）；commit+refresh；不调用 `_require_enabled`。

无。

无。

3. **`_escape_like` 重复实现** — [app/modules/skills/service.py:404](app/modules/skills/service.py#L404-L406) 与 [app/modules/admin/service.py:54](app/modules/admin/service.py#L54-L56) 完全相同。T4 文件清单限制下复制可接受，但后续建议抽到 `app/core` 共用，避免转义规则漂移。
4. **排序缺少 tie-break** — [app/modules/skills/service.py:425](app/modules/skills/service.py#L425)：仅 `Skill.name.asc()`，而 `skills.name` 无唯一约束，同名系统技能多次请求顺序可能不稳定。建议 `order_by(Skill.name.asc(), Skill.id.asc())`。
5. **测试缺口：已有行再次保存时 `updated_at` 刷新未被覆盖** — [test_admin_instructions.py:111](tests/integration/test_admin_instructions.py#L111-L143) 只测插入路径，null 用例是“插入→删除→再插入”，没有覆盖“行已存在时第二次 PUT”的手动 `updated_at` 分支；实现正确但无回归保护。建议连续两次 PUT 不同内容并断言 `updated_at` 严格变大。
6. **测试缺口：管理端不合并用户覆盖未被直接断言** — [test_admin_skills.py:189](tests/integration/test_admin_skills.py#L189-L248) 中用户覆盖是 `true`，与全局一致；缺少“用户把全局启用的系统技能覆盖为 `false`，管理端仍显示 `effective_enabled=true`”的断言，而这正是 R1 之外 T4 的关键口径。
7. **测试缺口：`q` 只测名称与 `%`** — [test_admin_skills.py:128](tests/integration/test_admin_skills.py#L128-L141)：未测描述字段匹配，也未测 `_` 与 `\` 的转义（brief 要求匹配名称/描述并转义）。建议补 `q` 命中种子描述、`q="_"` 等用例。
8. **`stats` 口径需 T7 文档确认** — [app/modules/admin/router.py:147](app/modules/admin/router.py#L147-L157)：`stats` 按当前过滤结果统计（`total==len(items)`）；brief 只给出字段未定义全局/筛选语义，实现与测试固定为筛选后口径，建议文档明确。
9. **R10 scope 口径张力** — [app/modules/skills/service.py:473](app/modules/skills/service.py#L473)：`skill.force_disable` 的 detail 只有 `force_disabled`，无 `scope="system"`；这与 T4 brief 一致、与计划 R10 括注“系统项写操作 detail 标 scope/source”有轻微张力，建议 T7 文档统一（若严格按 R10 则需同步改测试）。
10. **`is_default` 在“坏形态行存在”时字面语义偏差** — [app/modules/admin/service.py:271](app/modules/admin/service.py#L271) 以 `row is None` 推导，而 [app/modules/instructions/service.py:45](app/modules/instructions/service.py#L45-L47) 对形态非法行返回 `(DEFAULT, None)`，于是 DB 中存在坏行时响应 `is_default=true`、`updated_at=null`。这是计划自身定义的行为并有测试固定，但字段说明“无行=true”需要 T7 文档补一句边界说明。
11. **enabled 端点复用 `SkillEnabledRequest` 导致多余字段被忽略** — [app/modules/admin/schemas.py:116](app/modules/admin/schemas.py#L116-L120) 只给 force-disable 请求加了 `extra="forbid"`（brief 要求 enabled 复用既有请求模型，因此这是合规的）。但管理员误把 `force_disabled` 传给 `/enabled` 会被静默忽略；后续如要两端一致，可给 `SkillEnabledRequest` 加 `extra="forbid"`，需同步回归运行态 `PUT /skills/{id}/enabled`。
